settingsDnd.deviceIntegrationTitle: 🎮 External Device Integration (Logitech G HUB / Stream Deck, etc.)
settingsDnd.deviceIntegrationSub: Generate and download scripts to toggle or control DND (Do Not Disturb / Meeting mode) with a single tap from Logitech G keys or Elgato Stream Deck buttons.
settingsDnd.deviceIntegrationHostHelp: * Specify the IP address and port accessible within your home LAN (e.g., http://192.168.1.100:8080).
settingsDnd.deviceIntegrationFormatBat: .bat (Windows / Logitech G HUB & Stream Deck Recommended)
settingsDnd.guideStepGHUB1: Download the generated batch script (e.g. voicehub_dnd_toggle.bat) and save it to a folder on your PC (e.g. Documents\VoiceHub\).
settingsDnd.guideStepGHUB2: Open Logitech G HUB and select the mouse or keyboard profile you want to customize.
settingsDnd.guideStepGHUB3: Click the Assignments icon on the left menu and open the System tab.
settingsDnd.guideStepGHUB4: Under Launch Application, click Add and select the downloaded batch file (.bat) directly.
settingsDnd.guideStepGHUB5: Drag and drop the registered entry onto your desired G key or mouse side button.
settingsDnd.guideTipGHUB:
💡 Simple G HUB Setup:
On Windows, simply select the downloaded .bat file directly in Launch Application. No special executables (wscript.exe, powershell.exe) or command-line arguments needed.
settingsDnd.guideStepStreamDeck1: Download the generated batch script (e.g. voicehub_dnd_toggle.bat) and save it to a folder on your PC.
settingsDnd.guideStepStreamDeck2: Launch the Elgato Stream Deck configuration application.
settingsDnd.guideStepStreamDeck3: Drag and drop the "Open" action from the "System" category in the right sidebar onto an empty key.
settingsDnd.guideStepStreamDeck4: In the property inspector at the bottom, click "..." next to App / File and select the downloaded batch file (.bat).
settingsDnd.guideStepStreamDeck5: Optionally name the key "DND" and set an appropriate icon (e.g. mic mute or moon icon).
settingsDnd.guideTipStreamDeck: 💡 Pro-tip: If you have spare keys, assign "Toggle", "30m Meeting", and "Unmute" side-by-side for instant one-touch control during urgent calls!

settingsWebhook.tokenGuideFull: When calling the speech API from outside (e.g. via Cloudflare Tunnel), supply this token in the header or parameters. You can change it directly here or in .my.env.

settingsWebhook.timeHelpFull: 💡 Past times trigger immediate speech; future times (+10m or 19:30) trigger at scheduled times. Updates cURL / JSON / IFTTT snippets in real time.
settingsWebhook.geminiGuideBody: Instead of storing a shared API key on the server, you can give custom instructions to "Gemini used by each person (Web / Advanced / Gems)" to broadcast personalized daily schedule and weather summaries through home speakers.
settingsWebhook.geminiSamplePrompt:
Please check my Google Calendar schedule for today and the current weather, and compose a bright, cheerful morning greeting and a 1-day summary (about 150 characters).
Then send a POST request to the following Webhook API to announce it on my home speakers:

■ Target Webhook:
POST http://<SERVER_IP>:8080/api/say  (or Cloudflare Tunnel URL)
Headers: Content-Type: application/json
Body:
{
  "text": "Generated summary text",
  "devices": ["Living Room", "Study"]
}
settingsWebhook.cfDomainAutoNotice: Automatically auto-completed from configuration (CLOUDFLARE_TUNNEL_DOMAIN in .my.env). Can be changed if needed.
